blocks.title: Crystal lattice
blocks.text: Teen-dimensional (3D) jagah mein ions, atoms ya molecules ki ba-qaida (regular) tarteeb ko crystal lattice kehte hain.
Jin solids ki shakal fixed, ba-qaida aur teen-dimensional geometric ho, unhen crystalline solids kehte hain. Misalein: heera (diamond), sodium chloride (namak), barf (ice) waghera.

Har crystalline solid ki ek fixed aur pehchanne wali geometrical shakal hoti hai, kyunke us ke atoms, ions ya molecules 3D jagah mein muqarrar aur ba-tarteeb tareeqe se lage hote hain. Kisi crystal ke chehron (faces) ke darmiyan zawiye (interfacial angles) hamesha ek jaise rehte hain, chahe crystal kisi bhi size ya shakal mein ugaya jaye. Crystal ko pees kar bareek powder bana dein, tab bhi us ke chehre aur zawiye wahi rehte hain.
Crystalline solids ek bilkul muqarrar (sharp) temperature par pighalte hain. Isi melting point se unhen pehchana ja sakta hai.

Crystalline solid tootta hai to hamesha muqarrar satahon (planes) ke saath tootta hai. Inhen cleavage planes kehte hain. Kisi ek solid ke liye yeh planes ek doosre se ek khas zawiye par hoti hain, aur yeh zawiya har solid ka apna hota hai.

Kisi crystalline cheez ka munasib solvent mein saturated ya supersaturated solution (jis mein had se zyada cheez ghuli ho) ho, to us ke atoms, ions ya molecules tarteeb se jur kar usi qisam ke crystals bana dete hain. Ise growth of crystals kehte hain. Yeh solvent ko aahista aahista evaporate kar ke ya saturated solution mein chhota crystal dal kar (seeding) kiya jata hai.

Misal: sodium thiosulphate (Na₂S₂O₃) ki pani mein solubility 100 °C par 231 g/100 cm³ aur room temperature par 50 g/100 cm³ hai. 100 °C par saturated solution ko aahista thanda karein to crystal nahi bante; yeh supersaturated solution solid ke saath equilibrium mein nahi hota. Ab is mein Na₂S₂O₃ ka ek chhota crystal dal dein to crystallization foran tezi se ho jati hai.

blocks.title: Habit of a crystal
blocks.text: Crystal jis shakal mein aam taur par ugta hai, use us crystal ki habit kehte hain.

Agar crystal ugane ki shartein (conditions) wahi rakhi jayein to crystal ki shakal hamesha wahi rehti hai. Shartein badlein to shakal badal sakti hai. Maslan NaCl ka cube (mukaab) jaisa crystal, solution mein 10% urea bator milawat (impurity) ho to sui (needle) jaisa ban jata hai.

blocks.title: Asaan alfaaz mein
blocks.text: Seed crystal ek saanche (template) ka kaam karta hai: supersaturated solution ke izafi particles ko jurne ke liye ek ba-qaida satah mil jati hai, is liye crystallization foran shuru ho jati hai.

items: Crystal lattice: particles ki ba-qaida 3D tarteeb; crystalline solids (heera, NaCl, barf).

Properties: fixed geometrical shakal aur interfacial angles, sharp melting point, cleavage planes, saturated/supersaturated solution se crystal growth (Na₂S₂O₃: 100 °C par 231 g, room temperature par 50 g fi 100 cm³), aur habit (NaCl ka cube 10% urea se sui jaisa).
